Title 'At Hidden Layer' (red, bold, underlined) at top-left; a small yellow circle badge with purple outline containing '21' at top-right. A second, smaller red-outlined white box sits at the bottom-left of the slide, below the main panel, holding the simplified weight-update equation and the 'Where:' definition line. The right side of the lower half of the slide is empty white space.
